title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper SIGMo: High-Throughput Batched Subgraph Isomorphism on GPUs for Molecular Matching
problem: Artifact evaluation and reproducibility verification of GPU-accelerated subgraph isomorphism for molecular matching
motivation: Reproducibility is critical for validating scientific claims in high-performance computing; this report documents evaluation of the SIGMo artifact submission
method: The evaluation ran the published GPU code for subgraph matching—finding whether smaller molecular structures exist within larger ones—on test cases by combining multiple queries into batches to maximize the GPU's parallel processing efficiency. Measurements were taken and compared against the original paper's reported results to confirm the batching approach delivered the claimed speedups.
key_novelty: Independent confirmation that batch-processing multiple subgraph matching queries on a GPU for molecular analysis produces the speedups the original paper reported.
contributions: Artifact evaluation report for SIGMo paper
Validation of GPU-accelerated molecular matching implementation
limitations: Reproducibility report only; limited details on actual performance improvements
